business_problem: Authentic needed to generate large volumes of brand-compliant ecommerce media quickly across a broad portfolio without forcing creative teams to bounce between disconnected enhancement and video tools.
solution_summary: Authentic Brands Group uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Authentic needed to generate large volumes of brand-compliant ecommerce media quickly across a broad portfolio without forcing creative teams to bounce between disconnected enhancement and video tools. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform provides the managed foundation where Authentic can access and operationalize the AI models behind its media workflows, serving as the serving layer. Gemini powers the enhancement layer that upscales, annotates, and edits ecommerce images in real time, serving as the compute layer. Veo 3 generates additional video and motion assets such as seasonal or localized ecommerce variants, serving as the compute layer. Product imagery enters the Authentic Images workflow on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Gemini enhances and edits the assets in place, and Veo 3 extends those assets into video-ready ecommerce variants for specific campaigns or seasons.
